description: Take trip requests by phone, fax, and the facility portal; check level of service and certification statement needs; book the trip on the schedule; redirect callers who describe an emergency to 911
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Hospitals call several providers for discharges and move to a competitor after one missed day; about $3,000 of revenue a day; calls that describe emergencies must be redirected at once
manual_workaround: Forward request lines to the on-call phone; write requests on paper intake forms; book on the printed run sheet; facilities fax requests to the backup number
dependent_third_parties: Hosted phone vendor; operations platform vendor; internet provider

description: Assign trips to crews, track unit status, pass pickup details and changes to crews, and keep dialysis chair times
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patient safety: about 18 dialysis patients ride three times a week from 5:00 a.m. and a missed session is a safety event; discharges back up hospital beds; the platform vendor's stated RTO (4 h) is longer than this RTO, so manual dispatch must cover the gap
manual_workaround: Printed next-day run sheet; dispatch by phone call and text to the crew phones; status kept on a paper board
dependent_third_parties: Operations platform vendor; hosted phone vendor; cellular carrier

business_process: Patient care documentation and hospital record delivery
description: EMTs document each transport in the ePCR on the tablet; the record goes to the receiving hospital through the platform's hospital portal; records sync to the platform
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: State rule: the receiving hospital must be able to get the patient care record on request within 48 hours of dispatch (Rule 64J-1.014, F.A.C.); tablets work offline, so short outages lose little
manual_workaround: Tablets keep documenting offline; paper patient care report forms in each ambulance; leave a paper copy at the hospital

business_process: Medical necessity documentation and trip packets
description: Collect physician certification statements (PCS) and facility face sheets; attach them to the trip in the platform before the billing company bills
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Medicare: scheduled repetitive trips need a PCS dated no earlier than 60 days before the trip; unscheduled facility trips need one within 48 hours after (42 CFR 410.40(e)(2)-(3)); documents kept 7 years (42 CFR 424.516(f))
manual_workaround: Ask facilities to re-fax or upload; keep paper PCS in the binder until the platform is back
dependent_third_parties: Hosted phone and fax vendor; productivity suite vendor; facilities

description: The billing company pulls completed trips and PCS from the platform, codes them, and submits claims through its clearinghouse; the Office Manager works denials in its portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $21,000 billed a week; payers accept claims within filing limits; a 30-day cash reserve
manual_workaround: Hold trips; the billing company catches up when the platform interface returns; payer portals for urgent questions
dependent_third_parties: Billing company and its clearinghouse; payers

description: Daily vehicle and equipment checks, oxygen and supply levels, maintenance, and fleet GPS tracking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A BLS vehicle must carry the required equipment and two-way voice communication (42 CFR 410.41(a)); a missing check can take a unit out of service
manual_workaround: Paper check sheets in each ambulance; crew phones replace the tracker for location
dependent_third_parties: Fleet tracking service; vehicle maintenance shop; medical supply vendor

business_process: Crew scheduling, payroll, and certification tracking
description: Monthly crew schedule; biweekly payroll through a payroll service; tracking of EMT certifications and driver records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; certifications expire on known dates; the schedule changes weekly
manual_workaround: Printed monthly schedule; the payroll service repeats the prior payroll
dependent_third_parties: Payroll service; productivity suite vendor; MSP (backup)

business_process: State data reporting and records requests
description: ePCR data export to the state EMS data system; patient and facility record requests; release of information
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: State reporting runs on the platform's export schedule; record requests have no same-day deadline
manual_workaround: Back-enter paper patient care reports after the outage; answer record requests when the platform returns
dependent_third_parties: Operations platform vendor; state EMS data system
